simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַבָּט (H4007) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַבָּט (mabbâṭ) means something expected , i.e. (abstractly) expectation First listed occurrence: Isa 20 5.

definitions.full: H4007. mabbat or mebbat [ מַבָּט ] noun masculine Zech 9:5 expectation = object of hope or confidence (literally thing looked to ); — suffix מַבָּטֵנוּ Isa 20:6 , מַבָּטָם 20:5 , מֶבָּטָהּ Zech 9:5 ; — of Cush as ally of Judah Isa 20:5-6 , of Tyre as ally of l'hilistia Zech 9:5 .
